name: Light and colour sensors
author: Bench Workshop
description: A light-dependent resistor module (LDR), a BH1750 light meter (lux, I2C) and a TCS34725 colour sensor (I2C). They see the bench: the room light (the toolbar's Room button), anything held over them, and lit LEDs and screens. Includes BH1750.h and Adafruit_TCS34725.h.

parts.name: Light sensor module (LDR)
parts.description: A photoresistor with a comparator: AO rises as it gets darker (about 0.2 V in a lit room, near VCC in the dark), DO goes HIGH when it's darker than the blue pot's setting. VCC (3.3-5 V), GND, DO, AO. Switch the room dark (toolbar), or hold something over it.

parts.name: Light meter (BH1750)
parts.description: Measures light in lux (I2C at 0x23, or 0x5C with ADDR high). VCC (3.3-5 V), GND, SCL, SDA. #include <BH1750.h>; BH1750 lightMeter; lightMeter.begin(); lightMeter.readLightLevel().

parts.name: Colour sensor (TCS34725)
parts.description: Sees the colour of what's in front of its face (a few cm), lit by its white LED (LED pin: HIGH or unwired = on). I2C at 0x29. VIN (3.3-5 V), GND, SCL, SDA, LED. #include <Adafruit_TCS34725.h>; tcs.begin(); tcs.getRawData(&r, &g, &b, &c); or tcs.getRGB(&r, &g, &b). Glue it face down over where things pass.

examples.name: Night light
examples.description: An LED that comes on when it gets dark, and a light meter printing lux. Press Run, then press the toolbar's Room button to dim the room (or hold something over the sensors: drag a block over them).

examples.name: Colour names
examples.description: A colour sensor on an arm looks down at what's under it and prints the colour's name. Drag the coloured blocks under it one by one.
